item.title: 2025 Partnership with Fast & Fargère!
item.description: It is with immense pride that I announce my support for the Fast & Fargère karting team for the 2025 season!

item.title: 2026 Partnership: Still with Fast & Fargère!
item.description: It is with great enthusiasm that I renew my support for the Fast & Fargère karting team and Ismaël Fargère for the 2026 season! After a promising 2025 and his excellent past results, such as his superb 3rd place at the IAME Eurocup in Le Mans, Ismaël’s dedication and progress continue to impress. His rigorous training at the Sport-Études Karting section of Belmont-sur-Rance is paying off. I am very proud to continue supporting this young talent and local team towards new victories. Follow the adventure on their Facebook page!

item.title: Fast & Fargère Partnership 2024!
item.description: I’m happy to officially announce my partnership with the Fast & Fargère team. The 2024 year was already rich in emotions and successes with the victory in the general classification of the KA100 Rhône-Alpes karting ligue. Curious to see what this young prodigy will do in the coming years. He trains with the Sport-Études Karting section of Belmont-sur-Rance and remarkably took 3rd place at the IAME Eurocup in Le Mans!
